content: 1. Inform your doctor and pharmacist about all the products you are using, including prescription medications, over-the-counter drugs, and herbal supplements. 2. Do not use other vaginal products during treatment with this medication unless specifically instructed by your doctor. 3. If this medication is accidentally swallowed, it may be harmful. In case of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. 4. If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. However, do not exceed the prescribed number of doses in a single day. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. 5. Store this medication at room temperature. Do not flush it down the toilet or pour it into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard the product when it is expired or no longer needed. 6. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information tailored to your specific health needs. 7. This medication contains the hormone progesterone, which plays a role in helping you become and remain pregnant. 8. Before using this medication, read the patient information leaflet provided by your pharmacist. Follow the instructions carefully, and use the applicator to insert the medication into the vagina as directed by your doctor, typically two or three times a day. 9. To achieve the best results, use this medication consistently at evenly spaced intervals. 10. Common side effects may include bloating, stomach or abdominal pain, nausea, breast tenderness, headache, drowsiness, mood swings, irritability, or vaginal discomfort. 11. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. 12. Rarely, this medication, especially when used with estrogen products, may cause serious and potentially fatal complications such as blood clots, heart attack, stroke, or clots in the lungs, legs, or eyes. 13. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. 14. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar guidance. 15. Before using progesterone, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. 16. This medication may cause drowsiness. Alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities requiring alertness or clear vision until you can do so safely. 17. Limit alcoholic beverages and discuss marijuana use with your doctor. 18. This medication may be used during pregnancy but only under the direction of your doctor. 19. Progesterone passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor if you are breastfeeding. 20. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. 21. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use (including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. 22. Do not use other vaginal products during treatment with this medication unless directed by your doctor. 23. If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as passing out or trouble breathing, call 911. Otherwise, contact a poison control center immediately. 24. If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember, but do not exceed the prescribed daily dosage. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. 25. Store the medication at room temperature and dispose of it properly when expired or no longer needed. Do not flush it down the toilet or pour it into a drain unless instructed to do so. 26. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete and personalized information about this product and your specific health needs.
